title: Evaluate Candidates, Advance the Quality Ratchet, and Finalize the Run

story.so_that: accepted skill state only moves forward and every terminal outcome remains independently auditable
story.i_want: each valid candidate evaluated comparably, accepted only when it adds qualifying value, and summarized with the repository left at its best accepted state

journey.before: A refinement action has produced a scope-valid candidate, and a baseline or current-best accepted state with metrics has been recorded.
journey.during: The owner triggers the deterministic candidate evaluation, reviews the quality-ratchet comparison, and confirms the finalization report.
journey.after: The owner sees the repository restored to its best accepted state, the mutation lease released, and a complete terminal audit report published.

capability_breakdown.core_action: Evaluate a candidate using the same deterministic configuration as the baseline, compare it with the current best accepted state, accept only qualifying improvements, and finalize the run with an audit report and repository cleanup.
inputs: Baseline or current-best accepted state and metrics
Deterministic evaluation command, configuration, and pinned provider
Configured Activity timeout and retry policy
outputs: Recorded candidate metrics and artifact references
Acceptance or rejection decision for the candidate
Committed best accepted state or unchanged state
Terminal progress record and workflow result
state_changes: The best accepted state is updated to the qualifying candidate or kept unchanged
A terminal progress record is published for every terminal outcome
The repository mutation lease is released
The repository is restored to the best accepted state on termination

acceptance_criteria.criterion: EDD-007-AC1: Given a refinement action has completed and passed scope validation, when the candidate is evaluated, then the same deterministic evaluation command, configuration, and pinned provider used for the baseline are invoked again.
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given a refinement action has completed and passed scope validation when the candidate is evaluated then the same deterministic evaluation command configuration and pinned provider used for the baseline are invoked again
acceptance_criteria.jtbd: Evaluate a candidate with the baseline configuration

acceptance_criteria.criterion: EDD-007-AC2: Given the candidate evaluation completes, when results are recorded, then structured passing, failing, total, percentage, and required-coverage metrics and artifact references are captured.
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given the candidate evaluation completes when results are recorded then structured passing failing total percentage and required-coverage metrics and artifact references are captured

acceptance_criteria.criterion: EDD-007-AC3: Given the candidate evaluation exceeds its configured Activity timeout, when the timeout is reached, then the attempt is recorded, the configured retry policy is applied, and the attempt does not count as an additional logical iteration.
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given the candidate evaluation exceeds its configured Activity timeout when the timeout is reached then the attempt is recorded the configured retry policy is applied and the attempt does not count as an additional logical iteration
acceptance_criteria.jtbd: Apply timeout and retry policy to long-running evaluations

acceptance_criteria.criterion: EDD-007-AC4: Given the evaluation Activity errors for infrastructure reasons, when the failure is recorded, then it is not treated by itself as evidence of a product regression.
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given the evaluation Activity errors for infrastructure reasons when the failure is recorded then it is not treated by itself as evidence of a product regression
acceptance_criteria.jtbd: Avoid classifying infrastructure failures as regressions

acceptance_criteria.criterion: EDD-008-AC1: Given a candidate increases the absolute number of passing evaluations without reducing required test-case coverage, when comparison completes, then the change is committed deterministically, the consecutive-regression counter resets, and the candidate becomes the new best accepted state.
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given a candidate increases the absolute number of passing evaluations without reducing required test-case coverage when comparison completes then the change is committed deterministically the consecutive-regression counter resets and the candidate becomes the new best accepted state
acceptance_criteria.jtbd: Accept a candidate that increases absolute passing count

acceptance_criteria.criterion: EDD-008-AC2: Given a candidate covers a previously uncovered required test case while preserving the prior absolute passing count, when comparison completes, then the change may be committed and accepted even if a larger denominator lowers the pass percentage.
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given a candidate covers a previously uncovered required test case while preserving the prior absolute passing count when comparison completes then the change may be committed and accepted even if a larger denominator lowers the pass percentage
acceptance_criteria.jtbd: Accept meaningful new coverage even if percentage falls

acceptance_criteria.criterion: EDD-008-AC3: Given every required test case is already covered and a candidate only increases the total evaluation count, when comparison completes, then the candidate is not classified or committed as an improvement.
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given every required test case is already covered and a candidate only increases the total evaluation count when comparison completes then the candidate is not classified or committed as an improvement
acceptance_criteria.jtbd: Reject candidates that only inflate total evaluations

acceptance_criteria.criterion: EDD-008-AC4: Given a candidate performs worse than the current best accepted state, when comparison completes, then it is not immediately reverted or committed, and the workflow reruns the complete suite against the unchanged candidate before deciding.
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given a candidate performs worse than the current best accepted state when comparison completes then it is not immediately reverted or committed and the workflow reruns the complete suite against the unchanged candidate before deciding
acceptance_criteria.jtbd: Confirm a degraded candidate by rerunning the suite

acceptance_criteria.criterion: EDD-008-AC5: Given a candidate neither improves passing count nor adds meaningful coverage, when comparison completes, then no commit is made and the reason no qualifying value was added is recorded.
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given a candidate neither improves passing count nor adds meaningful coverage when comparison completes then no commit is made and the reason no qualifying value was added is recorded
acceptance_criteria.jtbd: Record why a non-qualifying candidate was rejected

acceptance_criteria.criterion: EDD-008-AC6: Given an evaluation expectation change was applied with human approval, when comparing before-change and after-change scores, then the two measurement contexts are kept separate rather than treated as directly comparable.
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given an evaluation expectation change was applied with human approval when comparing before-change and after-change scores then the two measurement contexts are kept separate rather than treated as directly comparable
acceptance_criteria.jtbd: Keep human-approved expectation changes in separate contexts

acceptance_criteria.criterion: EDD-011-AC1: Given a run reaches any terminal outcome, when finalization runs, then it publishes a terminal progress record and workflow result containing baseline and final metrics, absolute changes, terminal reason, accepted iteration and commit references, and rejected or reverted iteration summaries.
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given a run reaches any terminal outcome when finalization runs then it publishes a terminal progress record and workflow result containing baseline and final metrics absolute changes terminal reason accepted iteration and commit references and rejected or reverted iteration summaries
acceptance_criteria.jtbd: Publish a terminal progress record and workflow result

acceptance_criteria.criterion: EDD-011-AC2: Given a run reaches any terminal outcome, when finalization completes, then the repository mutation lease is released and the progress record identifies the target repository and final accepted commit.
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given a run reaches any terminal outcome when finalization completes then the repository mutation lease is released and the progress record identifies the target repository and final accepted commit
acceptance_criteria.jtbd: Release the mutation lease and identify the final accepted commit

acceptance_criteria.criterion: EDD-011-AC3: Given a run finalizes, when the terminal repository state is checked, then it corresponds to the best accepted state, not merely the last attempted state.
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given a run finalizes when the terminal repository state is checked then it corresponds to the best accepted state not merely the last attempted state
acceptance_criteria.jtbd: Restore the repository to the best accepted state

acceptance_criteria.criterion: EDD-011-AC4: Given pending human decisions or flaky-result evidence exist at the time of termination, when the report is published, then those pending or resolved items are included in the report rather than silently dropped.
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given pending human decisions or flaky-result evidence exist at the time of termination when the report is published then those pending or resolved items are included in the report rather than silently dropped
acceptance_criteria.jtbd: Include pending or flaky items in the final report

acceptance_criteria.criterion: EDD-011-AC5: Given the workflow terminates due to an unrecoverable error before any commit is accepted, when finalization runs, then the report still identifies the target repository, the failure reason, and that no accepted commit exists, and the lease is still released.
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given the workflow terminates due to an unrecoverable error before any commit is accepted when finalization runs then the report still identifies the target repository the failure reason and that no accepted commit exists and the lease is still released
